facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Morning came to the garden. The flowers held tiny dew drops. A ladybug climbed a green leaf. The leaf was bigger than the bug. But the ladybug kept trying. Ms. Clara stopped to watch. Her eyes grew warm and soft. She saw small kindness.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: In the early morning garden, dew sparkled on every petal like tiny stars. The sun was just rising, and a soft mist hung over the grass. A tiny ladybug crawled out from under a daisy, working hard to lift a fallen leaf out of the path. Ms. Clara was on her way to pick mint for tea when she noticed the little red creature. She knelt down on the cool grass and watched without speaking. The ladybug pushed and pulled, never giving up. "Even small things have kind hearts," she whispered, almost to herself. She saw small kindness in a tiny moment. Her own heart felt full.
